dedupe_keys.name: nearmap high resolution aerial imagery 3d models and ai derived property layers

description: Nearmap captures its own aerial imagery over urban areas and sells access to it, to 3D reality models and to AI-derived property data. Coverage: vertical imagery covering 88.5 percent of the US population, refreshed frequently in metropolitan areas and backed by a historical archive, at a ground sampling distance of 4.4 to 7 cm per pixel; products include vertical, true ortho, panorama, oblique, 3D and near-infrared imagery; the AI layers describe property features such as roof type, shape, pitch, material and condition, tree overhang, vegetation, surface types and solar panels, with peril risk products for fire, cyclone and hail exposure, wildfire defensible space and post-disaster damage classification (ImpactResponse). Format and access: the MapBrowser web application, a WMS 2.0 stream of vertical imagery, exports of georeferenced 2D, 3D and AI content in a chosen projection, APIs and SDKs, and integrations with Esri, Autodesk, Bentley, Cesium and Trimble tools; subscription, with demos on request. Licence: commercial; the website terms of use were read only as a link, not in full. Caveats: prices are not published; coverage outside the United States was not checked on the pages read; AI attributes are model outputs aimed at insurance underwriting and claims. Simulation uses: current building, roof and vegetation data for hazard exposure and damage assessment, emergency response after disasters, and city digital twins. Related records: Ecopia AI vector maps (data-ecopia-ai-vector-maps-buildings-land-cover-transport), which Nearmap co-launched for transportation features.
